questions.question_text: What does a triangular traffic sign with a red border and a white background pointing downwards indicate?
options: Stop sign
Give Way / Yield sign
No Entry sign
Pedestrian Crossing ahead
questions.explanation: An inverted red-and-white triangle specifically designates a 'Give Way' or 'Yield' sign, requiring drivers to give priority to traffic on the major road.

questions.question_text: According to standard traffic regulations, when is overtaking on the left side permitted?
options: On any multi-lane highway at any time
When the vehicle ahead is signaling and turning right, and there is sufficient lane width
Whenever traffic is moving slowly in the right lane
Overtaking on the left is strictly prohibited under all circumstances
questions.explanation: Standard rules require overtaking on the right, but overtaking on the left is legally permitted only if the vehicle in front has clearly indicated a right turn and room is available.

questions.question_text: What action must a driver take upon approaching a steady amber (yellow) traffic light?
options: Accelerate rapidly to clear the intersection before it turns red
Stop before entering the intersection unless the vehicle is too close to stop safely
Sound the horn and proceed without slowing down
Treat it as a green light and maintain speed
questions.explanation: A yellow light warns that the signal is about to turn red; drivers must stop if it is safe to do so to prevent intersection collisions.

questions.question_text: What is the legal implication of driving a motor vehicle without a valid third-party insurance policy in public areas?
options: It is a punishable offense subject to fines and potential legal penalties
It is permitted only during daylight hours
It is allowed if the driver has an international driving permit
It only applies to commercial transport vehicles, not private ones
questions.explanation: Valid third-party insurance is legally mandatory for all motor vehicles operating in public spaces to cover liabilities arising from accidents.

questions.question_text: What does a continuous white line painted along the center of a roadway signify?
options: Overtaking is permitted with caution
Crossing or overtaking across the line is strictly prohibited
Parking is allowed on both sides of the road
The speed limit is automatically doubled
questions.explanation: A solid (continuous) center line indicates hazardous road conditions where crossing over into the oncoming lane is illegal.

questions.question_text: What does a sign featuring a red circle with a horizontal white bar indicate?
options: No entry for all vehicular traffic
Mandatory parking area ahead
Priority for oncoming traffic
End of all speed restrictions
questions.explanation: A red circle with a white horizontal bar is the universal regulatory sign for 'No Entry'.

questions.question_text: When approaching a zebra crossing (pedestrian crossing) where pedestrians are waiting to cross, what is the driver's legal obligation?
options: Sound the horn to alert pedestrians and drive past cautiously
Stop the vehicle and yield the right-of-way to pedestrians
Speed up to pass the crossing before pedestrians step onto the road
Maintain current speed unless traffic police signal you to stop
questions.explanation: Drivers must legally yield to pedestrians waiting or walking on marked pedestrian crosswalks.

questions.question_text: What is the legal rule regarding towing a disabled vehicle on a public highway using a rope or chain?
options: The towing rope length must be unlimited to maintain safe distance
The rope or chain must be clearly flagged, and the towed vehicle must have a competent driver steering it
Headlights and indicators of both vehicles must remain turned off to save battery
Towing with a rope is permitted only on expressways at high speeds
questions.explanation: Safety regulations require clear visibility markers on the tow link and active steering control in the disabled vehicle.

questions.question_text: What does a broken (dashed) yellow line painted along the center of a two-way road signify?
options: Overtaking is strictly prohibited under all circumstances
Overtaking is permitted with caution, provided the oncoming lane is clear
The lane is reserved exclusively for public transport buses
Parking is allowed on both sides of the roadway
questions.explanation: A dashed yellow centerline indicates that passing is allowed when safe to do so.

questions.question_text: What action should a driver take upon hearing the siren of an approaching emergency vehicle (ambulance or fire truck)?
options: Accelerate rapidly to stay ahead of the emergency vehicle
Safely pull over to the extreme left side of the road and stop to clear a path
Maintain your exact speed and position in the center lane
Turn on your hazard lights and brake sharply in your current lane
questions.explanation: Drivers are legally required to give immediate, unobstructed passage to emergency vehicles by pulling to the side.

questions.question_text: What is the mandatory minimum age for obtaining a permanent driving license for a commercial transport vehicle in India?
options: 16 years
18 years
20 years
21 years
questions.explanation: Under the Motor Vehicles Act, applicants for transport/commercial driving licenses must be at least 20 years old.

questions.question_text: What does a blue circular sign with a white arrow pointing right indicate?
options: Mandatory turn right ahead
Right turn prohibited
Optional right lane
Dead end on the right
questions.explanation: Blue circular signs with white arrows give mandatory instructions that drivers must follow.
